entities.name: Ayman Siddiqi
entities.description: Former support member for the Sentinels who underwent intense combat training to integrate his technical skills with physical grit.
entities.quote: Ayman Siddiqi had always been the invisible hand, the quiet voice in their ears. He never threw a punch. Never drew blood.

entities.name: Sentinels
entities.description: A group that has scattered, leaving cities vulnerable to other-realm threats.
entities.quote: The Sentinels are broken. Cities groan under other-realm threats.

entities.name: Hidden Ones
entities.description: A disciplined group of assassins who operate in the shadows and reject the influence of the world order.
entities.quote: These people — they’re no puppets like the Sentinels. They don’t bow to corrupted world orders. They fight on their own terms.

timeline_events.title: The Fall of the Sentinels
timeline_events.description: The Sentinels disperse, leaving the world undefended and Ayman searching for a new purpose.
timeline_events.quote: But when the Sentinels scattered, the world bled. And his screens meant nothing anymore.

timeline_events.title: The Birth of Echogrim
timeline_events.description: After failing to integrate into the Hidden Ones as a standard fighter, Ayman combines his technical expertise with his training to become Echogrim.
timeline_events.quote: This was the birth of Echogrim.
